profile.headline: Backend Software Engineer @ MongoDB • MBA @ USC Marshall
profile.summary: Software developer passionate about innovating on education and community-building solutions through human-computer interaction development, especially in the areas of ubiquitous computing and gamification.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
* Led the cloud transformation of the on-premises Parallel Data Warehouse (PDW)/Microsoft Analytics Platform System (APS) into Azure Synapse Analytics, architecting a scalable, cloud-native solution that powers enterprise-scale analytics. Integrated services such as Azure Service Fabric, Monitoring, and Storage as part of the product’s cloud architecture to enable distributed computing, observability, and scalable storage.
* Drove technical excellence and defined the technical roadmap as a primary committer of Azure Synapse Analytics data ingestion scenario area, ensuring continued code quality, test coverage, and pipeline stability as engineering efforts shifted toward Microsoft Fabric. Proposed and led projects that reduced customer incident resolution costs and improved developer onboarding.
* Enhanced external data ingestion functionality (PolyBase and COPY INTO) to seamlessly bulk load and query against unstructured data, optimizing multi-core and multi-node parallelization (up to 60x speed up), Azure Data Lake Gen2 integration, automatic schema discovery for Parquet files, and integrating secure data access with Microsoft Entra ID. All this significantly reduced the complexity and latency of ETL processes for petabytes of user data, significantly reducing new customer churn by improving their first-time experience and unlocking insights into their data sooner. 
* Championed best practices by leading design reviews, enforcing code quality standards, and mentoring junior engineers. Established CI/CD best practices, ensuring that tests were rigorously maintained, reducing regressions, and improving developer efficiency. Modernized development workflows by introducing Maven integration into the Git repository, establishing a package management system where none previously existed.
* Led key collaborations with PMs, architects, and executives and partnered with teams, such as the Azure Storage and Azure Data Factory team, to develop the projects mentioned before.
positions.insights: Skills: Cloud Development · Big Data Analytics · Massively Parallel Processing · Agile Software Development · Enterprise Software
